data.long_meaning: The name Ijaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ij' which means 'rain', and 'Jaj' which means 'drop'. This name signifies the joy and vibrancy of a raindrop falling on the earth. The name Ijaj carries the meaning “Raindrop” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ijaj usually hope their child will grow to embody raindrop and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ijaj is a name that signifies the connection between the divine and the natural world. It reminds us of the joy and vibrancy of life and the importance of staying connected to nature.
data.etymology: Ijaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Raindrop.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ijaj total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
